title: Largest rectangle in a histogram
stepTitle: Stack and Queues [Learning, Pre-In-Post-fix, Monotonic Stack, Implementation]
category: Stack and Queues [Learning, Pre-In-Post-fix, Monotonic Stack, Implementation]
intuition: For each bar, find previous/next smaller; width = R-L-1; area = h*width. Monotonic stack.

approaches.title: Brute
Optimal: monotonic stack
approaches.code:
def largestRectangleArea(heights):
    h = heights + [0]
    st = [-1]
    best = 0
    for i, x in enumerate(h):
        while st[-1] != -1 and h[st[-1]] > x:
            height = h[st.pop()]
            width = i - st[-1] - 1
            best = max(best, height * width)
        st.append(i)
    return best

interviewInsight: Sentinel bar of height 0 simplifies flushing the stack.
